dataset.license: CC-BY-4.0 per current official repository record
dataset.attribution: Faizan Ahmed SM, Ghori MH, Khalid A, Nooruddin A, Adnan N, Lal A, Umer F. Annotated intraoral image dataset for dental caries detection. Scientific Data 12, 1297 (2025). DOI 10.1038/s41597-025-05647-9; dataset DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14827784.
dataset.selection: Complete intersection of original Benchmarking test COCO-referenced records and exact Daath yolo_split/labels/test stems at pinned commit; 17 records; no performance-based selection.
dataset.member_integrity: HTTP Content-Range checked; ZIP CRC32 checked and per-image SHA256 frozen
dataset.class_id_resolution: Use each COCO file category.name; official test 1=D,2=d differs from train/valid 1=d,2=D.

metrics.ap_protocol: 101-point interpolation, score-greedy one-to-one matches, IoU 0.50:0.05:0.95; per-image max_det is declared by runner
metrics.uncertainty_note: Wilson intervals treat boxes as independent and are descriptive only; correlated teeth/views and small selected sample preclude patient-level clinical inference.

interpretation: Quarantined diagnostic of incompatible source class-name contracts. Its low nominal-label metrics are not a clinical performance estimate or a usable disease-class benchmark.
